integrity: Proof and source comparisons are same-model reviewed; standalone exact and numerical checker embedded; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Infinite exchangeable beta-mixture; no pool-size ceiling or assay dilution; no false tests; fixed correlation in rare-prevalence limit. Historical priority provisional. The earlier 2010 working paper has only month-level date evidence; day-resolution online source date verified September 27, 2011.
title: Rare-prevalence pooling has an inverse-prevalence size law under beta-binomial clustering
